content:
**Night Eyes** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Brighter vision while sneaking.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain Night Vision while sneaking. | 002598E6 | 

Upon crouching, a sound effect will play and a bright filter will overlay the screen.

Prior to patch 1.0.3.10, all exterior game zones were significantly darker during the night and Night Eyes had much more value.
